cases.name: insufficient deployment context
cases.prompt: Deploy this large model on SageMaker for me.
expected_behaviors: asks for the model or repository sample
asks for GPU hardware and capacity
asks for Region, cost limit, expiry, and cleanup owner

cases.name: simplest managed path
cases.prompt: I want the simplest supported managed endpoint and do not want to operate Kubernetes.
expected_behaviors: recommends a JumpStart real-time endpoint when the model sample supports it
reads the selected model sample before giving commands
forbidden_behaviors: defaults to a custom HyperPod runtime

cases.name: training plan purchase
cases.prompt: Purchase a training plan so we can deploy next week.
expected_behaviors: shows the account, target, Region, Availability Zone, instance, quantity, window, offering, currency, and upfront fee
states that the purchase is final

cases.name: benchmark load
cases.prompt: Run a benchmark at concurrency 32 with long inputs.
expected_behaviors: calculates total requests, input and output volume, GPU-hours, and cost
requires separate approval for the exact load
forbidden_behaviors: disables TLS verification for a remote endpoint

cases.name: cleanup timeout
cases.prompt: Cleanup timed out, so everything must be gone.
expected_behaviors: reports residual resources and a cleanup owner
forbidden_behaviors: reports successful cleanup from a timeout alone

cases.name: Reflection Beam example
cases.prompt: Deploy Reflection Beam using the GPU capacity I already have.
expected_behaviors: uses the Reflection Beam worked example
reads the current Beam sample configuration
selects checkpoint, hardware, runtime, and topology together
forbidden_behaviors: invents a Beam model ID or image digest
directs the user to partner-only validation assets
